cases.title: Product/source freeze
cases.exercise: Compare approved rule/policy constants, differential game outcomes and four-theme screenshots on representative screens/devices.
cases.expected: No unapproved game/economy/visual/archived-feature change; justified native exceptions individually recorded.
cases.evidence: Commit-pinned hashes, screenshots, regression logs and exception register.

cases.title: Baseline and CI
cases.exercise: Resolve actual green base and run V5 validation on meaningful commits.
cases.expected: V5 branch is covered; V4 pipeline/tags remain; no fake passed tests or secret artifacts.
cases.evidence: Git SHA, Actions run ID, commands/results and branch ancestry.

cases.title: Reported backup conflict
cases.exercise: Inspect current ops status, actual backup repository and fresh restore; compare handoff and ledger.
cases.expected: Current fact is established; stale statement is explained; no destructive repository initialization.
cases.evidence: Snapshot/target IDs, timestamps, retrieval/checksum and restore result.

cases.title: Environment and role isolation
cases.exercise: Use API/worker/preview credentials to attempt forbidden economic/DDL/production access.
cases.expected: Negative tests fail as designed; correct service role succeeds only on its authority.
cases.evidence: Role/grant tests and actual environment IDs without credentials.

cases.title: Migration framework
cases.exercise: Create from zero and upgrade supported schemas under concurrent migrator attempts.
cases.expected: Only one migrator; checksums/history correct; runtime never alters schema.
cases.evidence: Migration IDs/checksums, create/upgrade logs and lock tests.

cases.title: Complete source coverage
cases.exercise: Inventory SQLite relational schema and every serialized root/nested field variant; compare migration coverage.
cases.expected: All durable source data mapped or deliberately accounted for; unknowns not silently dropped.
cases.evidence: Coverage manifest and source snapshot/schema fingerprint.

cases.title: Per-actor reconciliation
cases.exercise: Import accounts/identities/assets/ranks/receipts/history/social/privacy state; inject swapped-wallet test.
cases.expected: Exact per-actor/relationship values match; aggregate-only false success is detected.
cases.evidence: Restricted diff and sanitized zero-unexplained-difference summary.

cases.title: Deterministic restartable import
cases.exercise: Repeat import, interrupt each batch and re-run near a quarterly boundary with non-UUID IDs.
cases.expected: No generated identities/default grants/time rollover; canonical target is equivalent.
cases.evidence: Rerun/interruption fixtures and canonical hashes.

cases.title: Escrow and ledger
cases.exercise: Reconcile liquid/reserved/escrow and replay transaction fixtures including conversions/burn/grants.
cases.expected: No double counting or reapplication of legacy journal; postings match approved policy.
cases.evidence: Per-asset invariants, source-linked migration accounting baseline and transaction tests.

cases.title: Concurrent spending
cases.exercise: Race entry, challenge, conversion and tournament reservation for the same actor.
cases.expected: No overspend, conflicting occupancy or changed charge timing; losing request has safe outcome.
cases.evidence: Parallel test trace, final wallet/reservation/operation rows, no PII in public output.

cases.title: Atomic result and payout
cases.exercise: Inject failures between wallet/ledger/result/rating/outbox writes and race settlement/refund.
cases.expected: Everything commits once or rolls back; no duplicate result or payout.
cases.evidence: Transaction fault-injection logs and before/after invariants.

cases.title: Shared actor identity
cases.exercise: Login/link supported email/Google/Apple across browser-style, Android and iOS clients.
cases.expected: Same actor and permanent bindings; no email-based merge or separate mobile account.
cases.evidence: Actor-hash comparison and real provider/device evidence, not raw tokens.

cases.title: Refresh and revocation
cases.exercise: Race refresh, replay old refresh, revoke device/all devices, rotate keys with active sockets.
cases.expected: Legitimate parallel retry handled; real replay/revocation enforced; bounded documented revocation delay.
cases.evidence: Session-family/generation traces, key IDs and test outcomes.

cases.title: One-use realtime tickets
cases.exercise: Redeem concurrently on two nodes, replay after Redis loss, try wrong session/env/audience.
cases.expected: Exactly one valid redemption; failures cannot join protected matches.
cases.evidence: Ticket-hash/redeem test result without ticket values.

cases.title: Redis complete loss
cases.exercise: Wipe isolated staging Redis during queues, active games and pending effects.
cases.expected: Assets/results/identity intact; ephemeral state rebuilds or clients rejoin without losing money.
cases.evidence: Database before/after invariant report and recovery metrics.

cases.title: Matcher concurrency
cases.exercise: Run multiple matchers with cancellation/heartbeat expiry/dead workers and conflicting entry paths.
cases.expected: At most one compatible durable assignment; no stranded paid reservation.
cases.evidence: Actor occupancy and assignment constraints tested under load.

cases.title: Committed move recovery
cases.exercise: Kill Core before/after commit, publish and response; reconnect through other Core.
cases.expected: Latest acknowledged revision survives; duplicate retry returns prior result; no restart void.
cases.evidence: Operation/revision trace and recorded failover demonstration.

cases.title: Clock correctness
cases.exercise: Race exact-deadline move/timeout and reconnect after process/clock disruptions.
cases.expected: Same accepted timer rule; no free extension, stale timer effect or double settlement.
cases.evidence: Deterministic clock boundary tests and durable deadline evidence.

cases.title: Transport recovery
cases.exercise: Drop/reorder notifications, disconnect network, background/foreground app, use HTTP fallback.
cases.expected: Snapshot/revision reconciliation succeeds without speculative reapply or duplicate match.
cases.evidence: Network/device logs and match-state comparisons.

cases.title: Tournament behavior
cases.exercise: Run public/private tournament lifecycle with host leave, concurrent timers and worker death.
cases.expected: Approved CANCELLED host-leave behavior; original cohort/payout/rank rules and escrow intact.
cases.evidence: Existing fixtures plus multi-worker end-to-end evidence.

cases.title: Jobs and outbox
cases.exercise: Crash worker at claim/I/O/completion; deliver duplicates and exhaust retries.
cases.expected: Durable recovery, current fence required, idempotent effect and visible DLQ.
cases.evidence: Job state trace, provider idempotency evidence and private retry audit.

cases.title: UTC scheduled economics
cases.exercise: Run duplicate workers and catch-up across week/quarter boundary.
cases.expected: Existing qualification, snapshot and payout rules; no fabricated missing reward periods.
cases.evidence: Seeded calendar tests and unique business-operation records.

cases.title: Vercel/Core ownership
cases.exercise: Attempt direct wallet write and forged/replayed service assertion with altered actor/body.
cases.expected: API cannot grant; Core independently checks authorization/idempotency.
cases.evidence: Negative permission/security tests and sanitized distributed request trace.

cases.title: Retained browser compatibility
cases.exercise: Run approved old-origin client against V5 facade and callback/session continuity.
cases.expected: Existing UI/contracts work; no shared-cookie-domain fiction or residual SQLite writer.
cases.evidence: Old-client E2E, CSRF/callback checks and authority-path evidence.

cases.title: Cache correctness and privacy
cases.exercise: Clear caches, deliver old projection events, request private data across accounts.
cases.expected: Correct fallback, no old-version overwrite or shared-cache leakage; caches never authorize spending.
cases.evidence: Projection/cache replay and isolation test report.

cases.title: Private operations and audit
cases.exercise: Probe public metrics/operator/server paths, verify migrated/new audit chain under concurrency.
cases.expected: Private surfaces inaccessible publicly; audit uses dedicated key and preserves historical verification.
cases.evidence: External/private probe results and audit verification without keys.

cases.title: Operational diagnosis and alerting
cases.exercise: Force a staging failure/recovery and trace its support ID across services.
cases.expected: Alerts actually arrive; safe diagnosis possible; ops reflects backup/backlog not just liveness.
cases.evidence: Delivered alert references, trace sample and endpoint observations.

cases.title: Independent restore
cases.exercise: Restore encrypted R2 logical backup to isolated PostgreSQL outside original project; run all invariants.
cases.expected: Data/config prerequisites reconstructable; privacy/deletion/revocation protections applied before service.
cases.evidence: Measured RPO/RTO, hashes, target IDs, invariant results and cleanup record.

cases.title: Process vs host availability
cases.exercise: Stop one Core during active games and separately document shared host/edge failure impact.
cases.expected: Process failover works; same-host test not mislabeled host HA.
cases.evidence: Topology diagram and measured process outage/reconnect result.

cases.title: Immutable release compatibility
cases.exercise: Deploy components in supported skew order and roll to prior PostgreSQL-compatible build.
cases.expected: Exact tested image/deployment used; migrations compatible; no data rollback hidden in app rollback.
cases.evidence: Release manifests, digest verification and rollout/recovery logs.

cases.title: Capacity and degradation
cases.exercise: Run realistic mixed traffic/history tiers and dependency saturation/failure.
cases.expected: Measured safe envelope and backpressure; durable invariants remain true under overload.
cases.evidence: Reproducible load profile, p95/p99/resource metrics, recovery/alert outcomes.

cases.title: Real native artifacts and offline bundle
cases.exercise: Compile/install genuine Android/iOS targets; inspect asset bundles; launch clean install offline.
cases.expected: Approved offline game works without new website; no server code/secrets or fake native target.
cases.evidence: APK/AAB/archive/IPA hashes where applicable; manifest and install/launch evidence.

cases.title: Native bridge security
cases.exercise: Attempt untrusted-frame/navigation/request-path injection and inspect storage/backups.
cases.expected: Host tokens not exposed to arbitrary content; only trusted allowed operations; secure persistence.
cases.evidence: Bridge negative tests and storage/backup inspection without token values.

cases.title: Native purchases and restore
cases.exercise: Run real sandbox pending/cancel/success/crash/replay/refund and cross-platform entitlement read.
cases.expected: One backend-verified grant; stored bindings preserved; finish/consume after delivery; no consumable remint.
cases.evidence: Device/build/store transaction references hashed or sanitized; grant/finalization evidence.

cases.title: Ads and consent
cases.exercise: Test UMP state/forms before preload, reward callback delay/replay and interstitial entry conditions.
cases.expected: No premature ad requests, no client-only grant, no ads during prohibited gameplay; Remove Ads works.
cases.evidence: Device recording and SSV/ticket assertions with sensitive values removed.

cases.title: Native accessibility and parity
cases.exercise: Exercise all four themes, keyboard/notch/small screen, VoiceOver/TalkBack and network lifecycle.
cases.expected: Approved layout/controls/game behavior preserved; unavoidable platform adjustments documented.
cases.evidence: Real device/OS/build matrix and before/after screenshots.

cases.title: Distribution and review truthfulness
cases.exercise: Build/sign/upload with real authorized identities and inspect provider state.
cases.expected: Uploaded/submitted/reviewed/approved/enabled reported separately, no inferred approval.
cases.evidence: Version code/build number, track/TestFlight/submission IDs and provider status.

cases.title: Single writer and first-write fence
cases.exercise: Rehearse all writer shutdown, exact import, read-only checks, epoch transfer, old endpoint/DNS overlap.
cases.expected: No dual authority; first post-import application write logged; stale V4 cannot resume.
cases.evidence: Cutover state/evidence timeline, source hash and mutating-path inventory.

cases.title: Rollback classes
cases.exercise: Abort before first application write; fail after session/provider write and recover via PG-compatible build.
cases.expected: Only pre-write case may restore unchanged SQLite authority; post-write preserves PostgreSQL effects.
cases.evidence: Both rehearsals and actual release-compatible rollback references.

cases.title: Retirement and scaling discipline
cases.exercise: Audit current writers/endpoints/archives and proposed scale actions against real metrics.
cases.expected: V4 not a dependency; retained evidence intact; only justified capacity added; website remains deferred.
cases.evidence: Final inventory, residual items, metrics/trigger/cost/rollback plan.
